name: failing build, no question
turnText:
I attempted the migration but hit a blocker.

What I did:
- migrations/0042_add_indexes.sql: created
- src/db/schema.ts: updated types

Build output:
error TS2345: Argument of type 'string | undefined' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string' in src/db/client.ts line 88.

Build failed. I stopped here rather than force a cast, since client.ts is used by every query path. The null can only come from a missing DATABASE_URL env var.
